flag: none; Job A only via the hash-pinned approved list (not in approved.json until Peace posts /approve-rule on its proposal issue)
engine: peaceai/lib/derive-wire-v2.ts derives the edit from the issue's Behavior paragraph and data-described fakes / expects, in one of two closed templates: a bounded retry of the target's final `return this.F(..)` (the statements before it re-run per attempt, so each attempt signs again; each call gets its own AbortSignal.timeout; only a rejected call or a status the repo's existing predicate accepts is retried, while the existing limit predicate allows; the existing delay helper is awaited through an injected sleep, added to the class's config seam if missing), or a filtered, recorded skip of one awaited call in a for-of loop (a matching failure is pushed to an existing local list and the loop goes on; any other failure is re-thrown). It is reached through the EXISTING_EDIT kind in peaceai/lib/learned.ts when the spec carries the v2 vocabulary (all or none; isWire2Params). The derived edit passes the Job B static check (gradeExistingEditProblem), where the template is re-recognised exactly (retryEditShape / recordEditShape) and the hermetic walk runs before and after on the template with its timeout signal (retry) or its catch (skip) taken out.
scope: Retry: an async class method whose last statement is `return this.F(a[, init])` with F injected through `this.F = config.F ?? default`, the statements before it free of return / await / try / throw / loops / functions; S (1 number param, boolean), A (1 number param, boolean) and D (2 number params, number) are exported pure numeric helpers of the repo's in-scope source; the timeout and base wait are numbers stated in the Behavior paragraph. Recorded skip: one awaited statement or `const X = await ..` directly in a for-of loop over a parameter of an async target, the failing collaborator coming in through a parameter; the filter reads message / name / code / cause.code / cause.name / cause.message and compares it (equal or prefix) with a word of the Behavior paragraph; the list is an existing `const L: string[] = []` or `const L: { k: string; .. }[] = []` of the target declared before the loop; the record is one read, or the loop item and reads per field. Exactly one candidate must fit every example, and (retry) the no-retry, retry-every-response and no-limit twins must each miss them.
refusals: wire_trigger, wire_sections, wire_examples, wire_behavior_code (code anywhere in the issue), wire_task_truncated (the issue reaches the 2000-char objective cut), wire_params, wire_target, wire_retry_target, wire_retry_site, wire_retry_seam, wire_retry_timeout_unstated, wire_retry_base_unstated, wire_retry_examples, wire_retry_unpinned, wire_twin_fits, wire_record_not_async, wire_site_none, wire_site_ambiguous, wire_no_seam (the collaborator is built inside the target, e.g. src/host.ts runScannerHost's `new MarketsScanner`), wire_record_site, wire_record_loop, wire_record_entry, wire_fake_ambiguous, wire_fake_shared, wire_no_failing_example, wire_filter_unpinned (no non-matching error that must propagate), wire_skip_unpinned (no skipped item followed by a processed one), wire_no_fit, wire_ambiguous, wire_search_too_large, wire_shape, target_file_not_found, edit_path, edit_test_grammar, new_test_path_exists, and every Job B static refusal (edit_*)

evidence.note: The spec's evidence block is M98's mining (same edit family: one existing function or method, graded by a new fake-driven test). No upstream evidence specific to derived retries or recorded skips has been gathered; this is a team-picked skill (GAPS G18 / G26) and earns no coverage credit.

limits: One site per task. Retry: only the final `return this.F(..)` of a class method; no retry of a call that is not returned, no jitter, no Retry-After, no per-error-kind retry (every rejection counts as a network error); the cause of the last failure is the original error, unwrapped. Recorded skip: no bare `continue` (v1's catch-all continue form is never used for per-day / per-session wiring; G26), no new list, no logging call, no counter of failures in a row, no seam derived for a collaborator built inside the target (refused as wire_no_seam; the host.ts per-day task needs a separate extract-the-loop task first). The Behavior paragraph may not quote a literal (the filter word is written bare, e.g. R2_).
